spanish: Y cuadrearás la túnica lino fino, y harás turbante lino fino, y cinto harás obra de bordador.

findings.issue: cuadrearás means giving the tunic a square shape; piel H7660 licenses plaiting or checker-weaving it (or setting), so the Spanish adds squaring and drops that action

notes: Person, number, articles, both make-verbs, shesh as lino fino, and obra de bordador match the other tokens.
